BookCategory.title: BookCategory
BookCategory.description: A library category stored in Firestore (document ID mapped via @DocumentId).

name.description: Display name of the category (1..80 chars).

shortName.description: Compact multiline or short label for category tiles.

description.description: Optional summary description for the category.

icon.description: Icon style identifier (stories, science, fiction, history, motivation, tech, islamic, other).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

Book.title: Book
Book.description: A PDF book catalog record synced via Firestore (document ID mapped via @DocumentId).

author.description: Book author or publisher name (1..120 chars).

categoryId.description: Reference ID of the category document in /categories/{categoryId}.

coverUrl.description: Optional HTTPS or Drive cover image URL.

driveFileId.description: Optional Google Drive file ID for the hosted PDF.

coverDriveFileId.description: Optional Google Drive file ID for the hosted cover image.

pdfUrl.description: Optional HTTPS or Drive PDF access URL.

pdfAssetPath.description: Optional bundled local asset path for offline sample editions.

fileSizeBytes.description: Exact PDF file size in bytes.

language.description: Primary language of the PDF book.

coverStyle.description: Generated cover artwork enum name fallback.

featured.description: Whether the book appears in Featured Books.

popular.description: Whether the book appears in Popular Books.

recent.description: Whether the book appears in Recently Added.

published.description: Controls public visibility; unpublished drafts are admin-only.

createdByUid.description: Firebase UID of the administrator who created the record.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the administrator who last updated the record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Server-managed administrator role record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

active.description: Whether admin access is currently active.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Publicly readable book categories managed exclusively by verified administrators.

/books/{bookId}.description: PDF books catalog. Published books (published == true) are readable by readers; drafts and mutations are admin-only.

/admins/{userId}.description: Server-provisioned administrator allowlist. Users may read only their own document to verify admin status; client writes are forbidden.
